notes.title: AoW Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Users.

First of all, let me apologize for the long radio silence on Steam. 
Even though I've update bi-monthly on other platforms since September, I felt like a Steam update had to be big enough to warrant posting something here.

Thus, I present to you the new Ashes of War version, with a lot of re-writes for the entire game, focusing on more natural interactions between the cast, animated CGs, both the H-CGs and the "regular" ones, new sprites, new characters, new backgrounds, and the first version of the revamped battle system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43427184/33d6df17583c4119523e279f90753ed576b4f209.png

Said battle system is still in its infancy, and requires a lot more work, but is here to give you a taste of the final product. It is at this time, still quite easy, but the groundwork for a "Hard / Challenge" mode has been worked on, and will come for the full release.

Speaking of the full release. 
The final version should be release around the beginning of Q2 2025, though I can't give an exact date just yet.

Still, I'm confident with the tools I have at the moment and hope to bring this story to the form it is supposed to have soon.

For the Steam users, I hope to do a monthly update from now on until the release, but once again, if you want more consistent news, I invite you to join the Discord.

notes.title: 1.19 Update and Kickstarter Announcment
notes.notes:
Good day,

I am finally able to push this new 1.19 update to Steam (1.18 was too small, so I skipped it on Steam).

You get more story with the assault on the TOHE base, some rewritten scenes, and some new sprites and CGs.

But what really took me the most time this past month, and what I would like to present to you, is the official Kickstarter for the Ashes of War project. This Kickstarter is mainly here to help improve the gameplay and the CGs of the game, and with it, I hope to be able to provide you something worthy of the best VNs you can find on the platform.

Of course, whatever happens, I'll continue working on the project.

But if you've enjoyed Ashes of War, I really hope you can consider helping me a bit more to bring this project to its full potential.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ashesofwar/ashes-of-war


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43427184/a67d7856e6d789281d4c06d08d61e2dfdfe6889b.png

It's probably the only time you'll be able to get some Ashes of War Figures too.

Regarding the game, I will now focus on polishing what already exists, with some rewrites and more character moments, so this is what the next update will bring.

With that, I would like to thank you for reading this, and I hope I will soon bring you more Tomboys in Space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43427184/ca865f6964a1565af40d875086b63357c8b74766.png

notes.title: AoW 1.17 Update
notes.notes:
It was high time to post a content update on Steam (as most end up in the discord for preview).

You've got a couple new scenes, CGs and 3D animations. Nothing major, but a bit more content for new and old players alike.

The english spelling and grammar should be quite solid until the mid-game now.

The CG gallery is still broken, it'll be fixed in a january update.

Thank you for checking the game, and I'll hope I'll come back with more content soon!

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.notes:
Slow but steady.

For this update, we've got a new scene, but I've mostly been concentrating on eradicating the typos (for now, only in the first part of the game) and adding different little flirt interactions.

I also fixed some bugs here and there, but if you still spot any, don't hestitate to report them one way or another.

Still not a lot of new things, but now, the first part of the game is pretty much as I envisionned (if you take out the battles), so once I've finished correcting everything, I hope to pick up the pace.

Thanks a lot for following the project.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Finally, I am adding new content to the game, with more coming soon!

Quick warning though, for this update, the new content is mostly for new players, with the implementation of a Map, a Codex for bits of lore (still WIP, it will be upgraded next update) and a re-write of a number of scenes.


Problems you will encounter:
CG Gallery isn' t updated just yet, so some of them cannot be unlocked.

The battle system is still quite clunky. I would not recommend engaging too much with it just yet, but if you find it decent enough, it's as you with.

And lastly, some saves will not compatible (if the script where the save was made was modified, which is pretty much every single one of them).

I do have good news. I've fount my rythm, and the next update should come in approximately 2 weeks, with hopefully the same rythm for at least the next few months.

As always, if you encounter bugs or want to provide feedback, don't hestitate to join the discord.

I can only thank you for your patience and hope you'll join us in our little community!

notes.title: Battle Module Update
notes.notes:
The first version of the Battle Module is here. 

I really wanted to implement some form of gameplay for the VN, and with this update it's now done, though I still have much more room for improvement. (Don't hesitate to provide feedback).
Though I added a tutorial, I hope it's not too hard to understand the mechanics (I should not be the case).

Next updates will focus on story. 

Thanks for playing !
